unlisted_practices: Comparing data retrieval strategies for LLM agents (direct FHIR API calls vs specialized tools)
Comparing single-turn vs multi-turn interaction patterns for LLM agents
Comparing natural-language vs code-generation reasoning strategies for EHR question answering

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated benchmark (FHIR-AgentBench) for assessing LLM agents performing question answering over HL7 FHIR EHR data using various agentic architectures and retrieval strategies, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
